name: GroupNormSwish

0.description: Group-normalized + Swish-activated output, same shape as input

description: Fused Group Normalization with Swish activation. torch_npu.npu_group_norm_swish(input, num_groups, weight, bias, eps, swish_scale) returns (output, mean, rstd). Pure PyTorch: GroupNorm + Swish(x*sigmoid(x)*swish_scale). Supports float16, bfloat16, float32.
